personality_one_liner: A clean, native e-commerce experience infused with a warm, earthy African palette, allowing products and boutiques to be the undisputed visual heroes.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for content. Safe areas meticulously respected. Cards fill horizontal space predictably with flex-wrap or full width minus padding.

do's: Use for sticky headers over scrolling content (like Home or Discover).
Overlay hero cards with glass content panels.
dont's: Never blur list rows, cards in dense product grids, or body content regions.
Avoid glass in forms or utility screens.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A rich discovery storefront featuring hero promos, categories, and trending boutiques.

states.loading: Skeleton UI representing the hero card and category chips.
states.empty: Lottie or SVG illustration of a storefront with a 'Nothing here yet' message.
states.error: Readable message 'Failed to load shops' with a prominent Retry button.

screens.layout: Top header with logo, search, and cart. Hero section featuring a promo banner card (with gradient scrim). Horizontal scrollable category chips below. Featured marketplace campaign or Trending Sellers carousel. A responsive 2-column product grid with sale items showcasing price, promo, and vendor attribution.

screens.name: Browse / Categories
screens.purpose: Allows users to dive deep into specific product verticals and shop vendor directories.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty basket with text 'No products found'.

screens.layout: Grid of categories using vector icons (NEVER emojis). Tapping a category opens a 2-column grid of products with filters pinned via glassmorphism header.

screens.name: Product Detail
screens.purpose: Showcases a single item with large imagery, multi-currency price, and immediate 'Add to Cart'.

states.loading: Skeleton overlay of the product image and text blocks.

screens.layout: Large hero photo (respecting top safe area). Scrollable content underneath containing title, vendor info, and prominent pricing (strike-through muted original price and primary colored promo price). Floating CTA button pinned to the bottom (Add to Cart) over a glass container.

screens.name: Wallet & Orders
screens.purpose: Consolidated loyalty wallet, multi-currency balance, and recent transaction/order tracking.
screens.layout: Top section: glanceable wallet card showing multi-currency balances (XOF, GHS, XAF) with a toggle. Middle section: tier level or loyalty progress bar. Bottom section: list of recent orders or vouchers. Clean, uncluttered layout emphasizing numerical data legibility.

hero_campaign.alt: African fashion hero model in warm setting

instructions_to_main_agent: REPLACE source site emojis with high-quality Phosphor icons. Zero emojis are allowed in the system UI.
App must default to French, but ensure spacing accommodates longer translations in Spanish and English.
Implement multi-currency (XOF/CFA, GHS, XAF) natively. Provide a clean currency toggle in the Wallet section. Since CFA numbers get large, ensure Plus Jakarta Sans font sizes adjust gracefully.
For promotions, show the original price muted with a strike-through, and the promo price enlarged using `brandPrimary` color.
Use a vertical gradient scrim (top-to-bottom, transparent to 70%+ surfaceInverse) whenever rendering text over a hero image.
Keep checkout and Add to Cart buttons sticky at the bottom of scrollable views using a glassmorphism container.
Ensure '1 iOS-Native Clean' guidelines are followed: spacing is generous (`lg`/`xl`), UI frames the product rather than distracting from it.
Strict color adherence: No blues, purples, or indigo anywhere. Stick to the terracotta, ochre, and sage palette.
